arguments.query: SELECT order_ts, status, typeof(order_ts) FROM orders LIMIT 3

WITH o AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-07-01' AND datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-10-01') SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM o)) AS gross, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM o)) AS refunds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) AS n
